answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that our intermediate pre-training strengthens the structural inductive bias of the model, resulting in a better few-shot performance for syntax-dependent seq2seq tasks, such as conversion from active to passive or chunking.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates transformed sentences based on syntactic transformations, such as passive voice, emphasized adjectives/verbs, and chunked phrases, as well as logical forms in semantic parsing.
